summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the appointment of Duncan J. Bullock to its Board of Directors as a non-executive director, effective the same date. Bullock brings over 17 years of investment and finance experience in the energy sector across developed and emerging markets, covering conventional and renewable infrastructure. No financial terms, stake changes, premiums, or transaction mechanics were disclosed, and no advisor was named. This is a routine board appointment rather than a forced or abrupt executive departure, so it does not constitute a special situation; there is no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
